findings.detail: Azure Kubernetes Service ends standard support for Kubernetes 1.34 on 2026-11-30; the cluster then moves to extended support until 2027-11-30, when Azure Kubernetes Service stops supporting it.
findings.remediation: Upgrade the control plane to a Kubernetes minor that is still in standard support.
findings.title: Kubernetes 1.34 leaves Azure Kubernetes Service standard support on 2026-11-30
